content.text: Section 19 meets or exceeds the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term. Vendor warrants it has authority to enter the Agreement and grant the rights stated here.
input.rationale: Section 19 delivers the preferred position in full: 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus material conformity to documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformance warranty running from the later of delivery or acceptance and, for Hosted Services, conformance throughout the entire subscription term (better than the 12-month software benchmark); 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law, no malicious code, no functionality diminution and open-source protection; and 19.4 provides re-performance, repair or replacement with a termination-and-refund backstop, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 does not swallow the express warranty — it is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and states that no disclaimer limits any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy. Section 3.1 reinforces the performance standard and Section 6 acceptance remedies (correction cycles plus refund) are consistent. No edit required.
